meta.verifier: 10/10 top claims PASS (board #13); 2 verifier statements corrected

findings.title: Unvalidated role input defeats policy
findings.evidence: input.role is a type cast, not validation. evaluateActionForMember only handles 5 roles and ends with allow. role:"root" allowed edits outside workspace and shell; role:"coordinator" grants complete/kill authority.
findings.fix: Allow-list worker|verifier|monitor|narrator at the tool boundary; reject unknown; default-deny in policy; never spawn a coordinator row.

findings.title: fork copies any transcript including coordinator
findings.evidence: Any caller can fork by member name; no hierarchy check; fork branch skips buildRolePermissions. Worker forks coordinator and reads full context. Latent: ctx.session.fork is absent in v2 adapter, so it throws today.
findings.fix: Coordinator-only fork; never fork upward; strip fork for non-coordinators (or remove the feature).

findings.title: allowCoordinatorEdits=false bypassable via shell
findings.evidence: Coordinator permission set denies edit only, no shell rule; isShell falls through to allow at policy.ts:159. Verified: coordinator edit denied, shell allowed.
findings.fix: When false, deny or force ask on shell too; document shell == edit.

findings.title: Tool classification denylist misses MCP/write_file
findings.evidence: Only 8 write names and 6 shell names recognized. verifier + write_file = allow; verifier + mcp_filesystem_write = allow. Live Code-Mode execute wrote outside workspace unpoliced.
findings.fix: Classify by permission action; per-role tool allow-list; deny unknown/MCP tools for read-only roles; require targets.

findings.title: Dangling symlink escapes workspace fence
findings.evidence: resolveCanonicalAncestor walks with existsSync; a broken link returns false and is reattached under root. Reproduced write outside workspace through ghost.txt -> outside target.
findings.fix: Use lstatSync for ancestor walk; reject when realpathSync throws; lstat final target; reject links outside/unresolvable.

findings.title: Glob-to-regex ReDoS wedges host
findings.evidence: Each **/ emits (?:.*/)?, no cap. N=8 -> 1.1s, N=10 -> >15s, N=12 -> >600s on a 40-segment path. Blocks single-threaded plugin.
findings.fix: Cap glob length <=256 and ** count <=8; reject consecutive **/**; use segment DP matcher.

findings.title: Read-only roles can spawn writers and take control actions
findings.evidence: No caller-role gate on add/title/channel/claim. Verifier can add an unscoped worker, claim broad globs, rename swarm, archive channels.
findings.fix: Gate add/title/channel create|archive/claim on caller.role === coordinator.

findings.title: Coordinator session stays edit-denied after complete
findings.evidence: ensureCoordinator applies coordinator permissions (edit deny when allowCoordinatorEdits=false); complete never restores them. Coordinator remains read-only after the swarm ends.
findings.fix: Restore/precompute permissions on complete and on kill; or scope permissions to swarm lifetime.

findings.title: Unscoped workers can write entire repo
findings.evidence: Ownership enforced only when myLocks.length > 0; worker with no owned_globs can edit any unlocked path.
findings.fix: For inherit, deny edits until at least one glob is claimed; deny paths outside owned globs.

findings.title: Startup recovery disables policy while sessions live
findings.evidence: Plugin load sets running/completing swarms to interrupted, members to stopped, deletes locks; hooks early-return on empty active swarms. Resumed sessions are unpoliced.
findings.fix: Interrupt member sessions during reconcile; key policy on live member rows; add owner heartbeat.

findings.title: Unregistered-session guard blocks unrelated sessions and subagents
findings.evidence: Any write/shell from a session without a member row throws while a swarm is active, including the user's other sessions and swarm-spawned subagents.
findings.fix: Allow sessions whose parent chain includes a member; scope the block to the swarm workspace.

findings.title: execute.before fails open without sessionID
findings.evidence: Returns silently; only permission.evaluate fail-closes. Write/shell paths without an edit/shell permission are unpoliced.
findings.fix: Throw when a swarm is active and sessionID is missing.

findings.title: git clone --shared exposes origin objects and path
findings.evidence: alternates points into the user's object store; shell-capable branch worker can gc/repack against it; absolute repo path disclosed; full history exposed.
findings.fix: Use --dissociate or worktree for both isolation modes.

findings.title: Windows worktree cleanup can skip prune and leak registrations
findings.evidence: If worktree remove fails and rmSync throws on a locked file, outer catch swallows it and prune never runs; crash recovery never cleans.
findings.fix: Isolate cleanup steps; always remove --force + prune --expire now with retry; delete branch in clone mode; reconcile on startup.

findings.title: Shell enforcement has no lifecycle bound
findings.evidence: Outside running|completing everything allows; completed swarm -> verifier edit = allow.
findings.fix: Enforce lifecycle independently of swarm status.

findings.title: No rate limit on posts/@all
findings.evidence: Worker looping @all wakes every member each time (cost DoS).
findings.fix: Rate-limit per member; restrict @all to coordinator.

findings.title: String "false" is truthy for allowCoordinatorEdits
findings.evidence: !options.allowCoordinatorEdits treats "false" as enabled.
findings.fix: Coerce === true.

findings.title: Read scoping bypass for killed/completed sessions
findings.evidence: Uses getLatestMemberBySession, so dead members still read history and absolute workspace_dir.
findings.fix: Require an active member for read_board/status.

findings.title: ..-prefixed legitimate names over-blocked
findings.evidence: rel.startsWith("..") rejects ..hidden/x.txt.
findings.fix: Use rel === ".." || rel.startsWith(".." + sep).

findings.title: Call-ID cache unbounded and contract-dependent
findings.evidence: Prunes only when >500; assumes permission source.id === execute.before.id.
findings.fix: Delete on use, hard-cap, warn on missing cached input.

findings.title: extractTargetPaths misses file/destination/to/from
findings.evidence: move/copy/rename yields no targets; workers fail closed but checks see nothing.
findings.fix: Add keys; deny write-tools with zero targets for all roles.

findings.title: kill compares raw names without normalizeHandle
findings.evidence: @Name silently misses.
findings.fix: Normalize target name.

findings.title: Stray Windows artifact breaks Linux checkout
findings.evidence: 102-byte file named nul.
findings.fix: Delete it.

findings.title: Restart permanently bricks new swarms in same session
findings.evidence: Unique index covers state != 'killed'; reconcile sets 'stopped'; recreate with same session throws UNIQUE constraint failed: members.session_id. Also happens after graceful restart.
findings.fix: Reconcile to killed (or delete/re-key coordinator); close swarm on shutdown; or scope index to active swarm status. Add regression test.

findings.title: startBoardServer hangs and can crash host on EADDRINUSE
findings.evidence: Promise resolves only in listen callback; no server.on('error'); second start on same port never settles and emits uncaught EADDRINUSE.
findings.fix: Attach server.once('error', reject) before listen; reject+close; add timeout and post-listen handler.

findings.title: Board API unauthenticated / CSRF / DNS-rebindable
findings.evidence: Cross-origin text/plain POST switched a member model (200); foreign Host read full board (743 B).
findings.fix: Random bearer token; require application/json; validate Origin/Host; reject unknown methods.

findings.title: Dead-owner file lock reported as claimed
findings.evidence: Dead owners skipped via liveIds; INSERT OR IGNORE swallows conflict; claimed returns glob while owner still dead member.
findings.fix: Delete/steal dead-owner locks in transaction; check changes > 0.

findings.title: Board head freezes at #500
findings.evidence: head from getPostsPage(...,0,500); 505 posts -> head 500, hasMore true; UI stops updating.
findings.fix: Use getLatestPost().swarm_seq or paginate.

findings.title: Channel isolation not enforced
findings.evidence: read_board accepts channel:'*' or any channel; postToBoard ignores subscription; channel ops ungated; subscribe allows ghost channels.
findings.fix: Membership checks on read/post; coordinator-only create/archive; reject unknown/archived channels.

findings.title: Wake fallback leaks channels and can double-wake
findings.evidence: Fallback feed uses channel '*' and advances cursor; main-only worker receives dev content. Waiter branch can prompt a session still blocked in swarm_wait.
findings.fix: Filter fallback to member channels; return when member is parked.

findings.title: Stuck working member disables stall monitor
findings.evidence: Any working member skips swarm; working set before prompt await; wake errors swallowed; one failure freezes monitoring.
findings.fix: Set waiting + last_error on wake failure; treat stale working as stalled.

findings.title: Quota-paused members can deadlock swarm
findings.evidence: Paused members skipped; flag persists through later successes; cleared only by setMemberModel. Paused coordinator never gets nudges.
findings.fix: Clear pausedQuota on execution.started/idle; let monitor/system posts bypass.

findings.title: Startup reconcile clobbers another live process's swarms
findings.evidence: Two DB handles sharing dbPath: db2.reconcile interrupts db1's live swarm. Two windows kill each other.
findings.fix: Owner boot-id/PID + heartbeat; reconcile only dead owners.

findings.title: withImmediateTransaction is not reentrant
findings.evidence: Nested transactional method throws cannot start a transaction within a transaction.
findings.fix: Add depth guard or document.

findings.title: busy_timeout=5000 blocks event loop
findings.evidence: Synchronous DatabaseSync can block HTTP+monitor up to 5s.
findings.fix: Use 1-2s and retry/backoff.

findings.title: Unbounded board request body
findings.evidence: No timeout/size cap; local memory DoS; shutdown waits on slow bodies.
findings.fix: Cap Content-Length/bytes and timeout.

findings.title: Nondeterministic default swarm in board UI
findings.evidence: getActiveSwarms()[0] has no ORDER BY/LIMIT; swarmId param exposes completed swarms.
findings.fix: Order/limit; reject completed by default.

findings.title: addPost does not advance author cursor
findings.evidence: Author's own posts count as unread.
findings.fix: Advance cursor for author.

findings.title: Stale branch/worktree breaks provisioning
findings.evidence: git worktree add -b / checkout -b fail on stale branch; no prune/-B.
findings.fix: Prune and use -B; handle leftovers.

findings.title: Duplicate main channel
findings.evidence: getMemberChannels can return duplicate main.
findings.fix: De-duplicate.

findings.title: No CSP header
findings.evidence: esc() escapes all interpolations; no injection found.
findings.fix: Add CSP as defense-in-depth.

findings.title: swarm add fork: is dead on every v2 host
findings.evidence: ctx.session is whitelisted; fork absent in 2.2.6 and 2.3.2 adapter, though @opencode/client exposes it. as-unknown cast hides it; guard throws every call.
findings.fix: Drop fork from schema/description, or implement via create(parentID)+replay; add capability probe.

findings.title: Activity label reads nonexistent data.tool
findings.evidence: session.tool.called.data has no tool field; every step label is 'Running tool'.
findings.fix: Use pendingCalls.get(String(data.id))?.tool ?? 'tool'.

findings.title: Coordinator model persisted before switch succeeds
findings.evidence: createSwarmWithCoordinator writes model first; switchModel failure only warns, so status lies.
findings.fix: Persist after success or roll back; re-read session.

findings.title: Permission cache key unbranded
findings.evidence: Assumes permission source.id === execute.before Tool.CallID; a permission-request id silently misses.
findings.fix: Assert source.type === 'tool'; fail closed or log when cache misses.

findings.title: Typecheck blind to host drift
findings.evidence: Derives Context from installed 2.3.2 with skipLibCheck; COMPAT-1 is proof.
findings.fix: Pin plugin types to host version or CI against host d.ts + capability probe.

findings.title: Package-root import pulls 2.3.2 runtime into host
findings.evidence: Root import eagerly re-exports 20 schema modules + effect 4.1.0 whereas only define is needed.
findings.fix: Import @opencode/plugin/promise/plugin or vendor define.

findings.title: Tests cannot catch compatibility breaks
findings.evidence: Mock model.list returns bare array, session.create returns {id}, command.transform no-op, /swarm and /swarm-models never executed, no fork/capability test.
findings.fix: Contract test against real adapter; assert ctx.session keys vs methods used.
